milestones.title: Sprint 1 - Data and evaluation harness
milestones.description: Goal: both datasets load with verified checksums, gold labels are derived and checked, the metrics are tested, and an OCR + LLM baseline is measured on the held-out test sets.

milestones.title: Sprint 2 - VLM extraction measured
milestones.description: Goal: local vision-language models extract the same fields zero-shot and few-shot, measured against the baseline on the same held-out documents, with review flags and a model card.

milestones.title: Sprint 3 - Serverless intake
milestones.description: Goal: documents arrive through API Gateway and TypeScript Lambdas, queue in SQS, are extracted by a GPU worker and read back, all from one Terraform module applied to the Floci emulator in CI.

milestones.title: Sprint 4 - Observability and release
milestones.description: Goal: the worker and the API have metrics and tested alerts, a Vertex AI adapter exists, and the measured results are documented and released.

milestones.title: Backlog
milestones.description: Work that needs an account or billing only the owner can set up (labelled blocked:account).

issues.title: Scaffold: uv project, settings from the environment, JSON logs, CI with lint, types, tests and a secret scan
issues.body:
As the owner, I want a project that checks itself on every push.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Python 3.12 package with ruff, mypy and pytest
- [ ] settings from environment variables with an `.env.example` and no secrets in the repository
- [ ] CI runs lint, types, tests, gitleaks and pip-audit

issues.title: Spike: which local vision-language models fit an 8 GB GPU and return valid JSON?
issues.body:
As the owner, I want to know which models are worth a full evaluation before building around one.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] one receipt through each candidate with a JSON schema; warm latency and VRAM recorded
- [ ] a decision on which models the evaluation runs, written into an ADR

issues.title: Datasets: CORD v2 and FATURA with verified checksums, loaders, and FATURA's held-out layout split
issues.body:
As an evaluator, I want the exact public files the results came from.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] a download script that checks each file against the publisher's checksum
- [ ] loaders for CORD v2 (validation for prompts and examples, test scored once) and FATURA
- [ ] FATURA test documents come only from the 10 layouts its authors hold out; few-shot examples only from the other 40

issues.title: FATURA gold fields parsed from the annotations, with a parse-rate report
issues.body:
As an evaluator, I want gold values I can trust, because FATURA's annotations include each field's printed label.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] a fixed invoice schema (dates, numbers, parties, amounts) parsed from the annotation text
- [ ] a data-quality report: parse rate per field, and every failure listed
- [ ] unit tests on real annotation strings

issues.title: Metrics: Donut field F1 and tree-edit accuracy for receipts, per-field match for invoices, bootstrap intervals
issues.body:
As an evaluator, I want the standard metrics, implemented so they can be checked.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] field-level F1 as Donut computes it, and normalised tree-edit-distance accuracy
- [ ] invoice fields compared after normalising amounts and dates
- [ ] tests against hand-computed cases; 95% bootstrap intervals

issues.title: OCR + LLM baseline: RapidOCR text to a local LLM with the same JSON schema
issues.body:
As an evaluator, I want the classical pipeline the VLMs have to beat.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] RapidOCR (ONNX) lines in reading order, sent to a local text model with the extraction schema
- [ ] measured on both test sets; latency per document

issues.title: VLM extractor through Ollama, zero-shot with a JSON schema
issues.body:
As an evaluator, I want each vision-language model measured the same way.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] image in, schema-constrained JSON out, validated against the schema
- [ ] every model chosen in the spike measured on both test sets, with latency

issues.title: Few-shot extraction with examples from training layouts only
issues.body:
As an evaluator, I want to know whether examples help on layouts the model has not seen.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] k example documents with their gold JSON in the prompt, never from a test layout
- [ ] measured against zero-shot on the same documents

issues.title: Business-rule checks that flag extractions for human review, measured
issues.body:
As an accounts-payable clerk, I want wrong extractions flagged before they are paid.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] arithmetic and format checks (items vs subtotal, subtotal + tax vs total, dates, amounts)
- [ ] how many wrong extractions the flags catch, and how many correct ones they flag

issues.title: Evaluation report and model card
issues.body:
As a reader, I want the results, the setup and the limits in one place.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] one committed report per run; a model card with the hardware, the data and the failure modes

issues.title: TypeScript Lambdas: submit (API key, validation, idempotent) and status
issues.body:
As a client system, I want to post a document and read its extraction back.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `POST /v1/documents` checks the key, type and size, stores the image in S3, records the job in DynamoDB and queues it in SQS; the same image twice is one job
- [ ] `GET /v1/documents/{id}` returns the status and the result
- [ ] unit tests with mocked AWS clients; typed, linted

issues.title: Terraform for S3, SQS with a dead-letter queue, DynamoDB, Lambda and API Gateway, applied to Floci
issues.body:
As the owner, I want the same infrastructure code for the emulator and for AWS.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] one module, two environments (Floci, AWS); least-privilege IAM per function
- [ ] applied to Floci in CI; validated, linted and scanned for AWS

issues.title: GPU worker: SQS consumer that extracts, validates and writes the result
issues.body:
As the owner, I want inference where the GPU is, behind the serverless front door.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] long-polls SQS, reads S3, writes the result to S3 and DynamoDB; a poison message ends in the dead-letter queue
- [ ] integration tests against Floci with Testcontainers

issues.title: End-to-end test and a k6 load test on the emulator
issues.body:
As the owner, I want the whole path tested and its front door measured.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] a document posted to API Gateway comes back extracted, in CI
- [ ] k6 on the submit path; results labelled as emulator numbers

issues.title: Worker and API metrics, alert rules with promtool tests
issues.body:
As on-call, I want to know when extraction stops, slows or starts failing review.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] worker metrics (jobs, latency, review flags, queue age) and health
- [ ] alert rules with promtool unit tests; a runbook entry per alert

issues.title: Vertex AI (Gemini) extractor, tested against recorded responses
issues.body:
As the owner, I want a managed-model option behind the same interface.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] the extractor through the Google Gen AI SDK in Vertex mode, with the same schema
- [ ] tests against recorded responses; not run against Vertex without the owner's billing go-ahead

issues.title: README, architecture, ADRs, runbook and release v1.0.0
issues.body:
As a hiring manager, I want to understand the problem, the design and the measured results in two minutes.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] README with the problem, how to run it, measured results with the hardware, and limits
- [ ] architecture diagram, ADRs, runbook

issues.title: Run the Vertex AI extractor on both test sets
issues.body: Needs a Google Cloud project with billing; about a few cents for 200 documents at the published Gemini Flash prices. Steps in docs/DEPLOY.md.

issues.title: Apply the Terraform to an AWS account
issues.body: Needs an AWS account. The same module that runs on Floci; steps in docs/DEPLOY.md.
